# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description — LogParser Pro

```html
<h2>LogParser Pro — Advanced Log Analysis and Monitoring in Your IDE</h2>

<p>
  Stop switching between your IDE and log viewers. LogParser Pro brings professional log analysis
  directly into your JetBrains IDE with syntax highlighting, real-time tailing, pattern matching,
  correlation tracking, and AI-powered anomaly detection for faster debugging.
</p>

<h3>Log Analysis</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Syntax Highlighting</b> — Color-coded log levels (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE) for JSON, plaintext, and common formats</li>
  <li><b>Log Level Filtering</b> — Filter entries by severity with one-click filtering</li>
  <li><b>Pattern Matching</b> — Regex-based search with saved patterns and auto-detection of Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and Java formats</li>
  <li><b>Stack Trace Folding</b> — Collapse exception traces for readability</li>
  <li><b>Dedicated Log Editor</b> — Custom editor for .log, .txt, and .out files with built-in tools</li>
</ul>

<h3>Real-Time Monitoring (Pro)</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Kubernetes and Docker Integration</b> — Native kubectl logs and Docker API for container log tailing</li>
  <li><b>SSH Remote Tailing</b> — Connect to remote servers for live log monitoring</li>
  <li><b>Multi-Source Monitoring</b> — Tail 10+ log sources simultaneously with RxJava streaming</li>
  <li><b>Alerting Engine</b> — Real-time notifications when specific patterns appear</li>
</ul>

<h3>Distributed Systems (Pro)</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Correlation ID Tracking</b> — Follow request flows across microservices</li>
  <li><b>AI Anomaly Detection</b> — ML-based pattern detection using Isolation Forest algorithm</li>
  <li><b>Advanced Filtering</b> — Composite filters with AND/OR/NOT logic</li>
  <li><b>Team Collaboration</b> — Shared queries, annotations, and JIRA/Slack integration</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pricing</h3>
<ul>
  <li><b>Free:</b> Syntax highlighting, log level filtering, pattern matching, stack trace folding, export to TXT</li>
  <li><b>Pro:</b> Correlation ID tracking, Kubernetes/Docker/SSH integration, real-time multi-source monitoring, AI anomaly detection, alerting, team collaboration</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
  <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ (or any JetBrains IDE build 232+)</li>
  <li>JDK 17+</li>
  <li>Kubernetes plugin (optional — for Kubernetes log support)</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<ul>
  <li><a href="https://github.com/JirakJ/logparser-premium-plugin/issues">Issue Tracker</a></li>
  <li><a href="https://github.com/JirakJ/logparser-premium-plugin">Documentation</a></li>
</ul>
```
